author: Iron
body:
I was added on Skype a few nights by somebody claiming to be Ginie. This was shortly after LFT. I went along with it, not 100% believing it. He was saying about how "m0xy had seen me in game" and "liked my melee skill and strategic play style".

My friend also made a LFT post, (Boodeeh)

He was added by Ginie aswell. (https://gyazo.com/878852a258f3c8de4856e43460f99f05) (https://gyazo.com/688cc9ea972ee4f5ee1fd5ce030848c9) Obviously we were so happy but we also didn't fully believe it.

He asked to join the Avicus team me and Boodeeh are part of and that I lead. I didn't want to add him since we don't need members right now, so I said no. He asked to join our slack group for our team - to see my maturity. I said no, since we don't even add trials to it. I came to the decision to let him scrim with us, why not?

I kinda believed it, but at the same time, I thought, what the fuck would Ginie want with two Avicus randies?

I kept in contact and decided to ask for evidence. He said "Oh, just wait until we scrim and you can talk to me in team speak".

I didn't really believe it, so I asked him to join my Avicus team's roster on the forums. Conveniently, he forgot his forum password. Earlier today I got a message from OCN player Givenchy_ saying if I had been invited to Street Sharks. I said that I wasn't because I didn't want anybody knowing, the only players that knew were my teammates. I asked him how he knew and he said a teammate of mine Eric told me. I asked Eric and he said "I have no contact with him at all". It was kind of getting hard to believe at this point so me and Boodeeh got on team speak to talk about it. We kinda stalked him. Budah said how his Skype says "Canada" whereas his time is GMT+4, the same as Givenchy's. I checked both profiles, Ginie's had 5 contacts. At this point I believed it was some bullshit so I messaged Givenchy on Skype along with Boodeeh. He replied and we both argued:https://gyazo.com/cf9fd5d7e5b818e65160a272e167d868 He then showed screenshots of our private slack and said they were from Sparks, literally one of the nicest guys in my team. I messaged him asking if he had leaked, he said no, he was then told he had an inside man. (Screenshots soon)

Well yeah, I don't want this to happen to anyone else and I want you guys to know how much of a dick Givenchy_ is for doing this.

If anyone wants to contact me about this then add downfallgaming123 on skype.

Thanks!

tl;dr Givenchy_ Impersonated Ginie.

Givenchy_ Skype: sultan-iphone - Fake Ginie Skype: ginie-private
